A large healthcare software business is looking for an experienced engineer to join the team. The role involves working within an agile environment to develop and maintain software components that support critical infrastructure. The successful candidate will contribute to the full software lifecycle, from design and technical conceptualization to implementation and maintenance.

What you'll be doing
• Developing software components across the full stack, including frontend, middleware, and backend systems.
• Taking responsibility for the entire software lifecycle, including design, implementation, and refactoring.
• Collaborating closely with product management to create and refine technical concepts.
• Working within an agile framework such as Scrum or SAFe to ensure high-quality delivery.
• Maintaining and documenting technical components to ensure long-term system stability.

What we're looking for
• Professional experience in software development using C#, .NET, and database technologies.
• A background in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field.
• Practical experience working within agile development teams and using tools like Visual Studio.
• Fluency in German (C1 level) and good proficiency in English.
• A proactive mindset with a strong focus on code quality and technical innovation.

What's on offer
• Access to individual professional development and training opportunities.
• Company pension scheme and retirement savings options.
• Health and wellness benefits, including fitness membership subsidies and cycle schemes.
• Employee discount programs across various partners and providers.

⚡ Project Details & Working Conditions:
· Project Period: October 26, 2026 – October 30, 2027
· Allocation: 100% (Full-time)
· Location: 90% Remote, approx. 10% onsite in Berlin
· Seniority Level: Senior
· Language: English is mandatory

💡 The Role & Responsibilities:
· Drive the further development of Wide-Area Monitoring Applications (including Advanced Monitoring, Load Frequency Control, and Power Quality).
· Analyze and adapt third-party open-source modules, including making active contributions back to the open-source community.
· Design, architect, and develop brand-new modules.
· Adapt deployment processes to align with Elia's new infrastructure requirements.

📌 Must-Have Qualifications: (Each must be evidenced by personal project references)
· A degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, a related field, or demonstrable equivalent professional experience.
· At least 5 years of experience developing IT solutions in line with enterprise IT strategies and standards.
· Python: Strong application development skills using FastAPI, Kafka, and Helm Charts.
· .NET: Solid experience in .NET application development with .NET 8+, EF Core, TDD, async programming, REST APIs, and authentication/authorisation architectures.
· Proven experience working with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, etc.).

🌟 Nice-to-Have Skills:
· Familiarity with Kubernetes, Argo CD, Protobuf, Pydantic, and Grafana.
· An academic or professional background in electrical engineering.
· Experience working with transmission system operators (TSOs) or comparable energy infrastructure companies.
· Knowledge of SCADA, PMU, PQ, protection, or fault record data.
